newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian finance ministry sees two pct 1997 growth.
newsitem.headline: Latvian finance ministry sees two pct 1997 growth.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product should rise around two percent next year, a finance ministry official said on Friday.
Latvia suffered a serious banking crisis in 1995 which sparked economic problems resulting in lower GDP that year and a subdued one percent growth this year.
"We cannot expect big (1997) growth," finance ministry director of analysis and forecasting Inna Shteinbuka told a news conference.
"This is a cautious forecast, since we experienced a considerable fall of GDP in 1995," she added.
She made the forecast when commenting about the findings of a team of European Union (EU) experts currently in Latvia to investigate its economic readiness for EU membership.
The main aim of the experts was to find out whether Latvia could generate economic growth, leading to higher standards of living for the population, Shteinbuke added.
